On the x-axis, Year is plotted. The y-axis measures Direct investments in billion U.S. dollars along a linear scale of range 0 to 20.
caption_L2L3: In 2000 the was very little us investment in Russia, apps 1 billion dollars. US investment peaked at 20 billion dollars in 2009 following year on year increases in investment from 2000 onwards. Investment since 2009 has been lower, but had remained within a band of approx 10-15 billion dollars each year ever since.
